brief.aim: The table was evidently assembled to predict whether a client subscribes to a term deposit (y, no/yes), so binary classification on y is the natural aim; call duration is only known after the call completes and encodes its outcome, so it must be excluded as leakage rather than used as a feature.
brief.repeated_subjects: No client identifier is present; the same client may appear across multiple contact attempts, but this cannot be resolved from the available columns.
brief.unit: One telemarketing contact attempt with a bank client (row of the campaign table)
